caption: Direct and Indirect / Reported Speech

lines: Direct speech: “I play soccer,” she said.
Reported speech: she said that she played soccer.
Direct speech: “I’m eating cereal,” he said.
Reported speech: he said that he was eating cereal.
Direct speech: “We have visited Greece five times,” they said.
Reported speech: they said that they had visited Greece five times.
Direct speech: “I have been drinking a lot of water,” she said.
Reported speech: she said that she had been drinking a lot of water.
Direct speech: “I danced with Tommy,” she said.
Reported speech: she said that she danced / had danced with Tommy.

body: Past continuous or past perfect continuous

lines: Direct speech: “I was avoiding my responsibilities,” Matt said
Reported speech: Matt said that he was avoiding / had been avoiding his responsibilities.
Direct speech: “I had accepted the offer,” you said.
Reported speech: you said that you had accepted the offer.
Direct speech: “I had been learning English for seven years,” she said.
Reported speech: she said that she had been learning English for seven years.
Direct speech: “I will buy it tomorrow,” Brian said.
Reported speech: Brian said that he would buy it the next / following day.
Direct speech: “I’m going to the city,” she said.
Reported speech: she said that she was going to go to the city.
Direct speech: “I would guess the answer,” he said.
Reported speech: he said that he would guess the answer.
Direct speech: “I can explain the topic,” Amanda said.
Reported speech: Amanda said that she could explain the topic.
Direct speech: “I could go,” she said.
Reported speech: She said that she could go.
Direct speech: “I should drink more water,” James said.
Reported speech: James said that he should drink more water.
Direct speech: “I must write the essay,” Jennifer said.
Reported speech: Jennifer said that she had to write the essay.
Direct speech: “I may go to the park,” he said.
Reported speech: He said that he might go to the park.
Direct speech: “I might identify the problem,” she said.
Reported speech: she said that she might identify the problem.
